C0924.title: Police Warn of Recruitment Brushing Scams Impersonating Internet Companies
C0924.summary: In May 2022, media reported fake job ads in WeChat groups impersonating internet companies such as Douyin, Ele.me, and Meituan. The report noted warnings from anti-fraud centers in Hunchun, Jilin and other places: the ads used roles such as 'like agent' and 'order placer' to funnel job seekers into brushing scams, first building trust with small rebates and then inducing victims to advance funds for fake orders.
